content: Abram Egipto-yargi-noargu, e-ome, degi, bela na ibmar-nikadi sealid. E-niga-Lot eba aligusmogad. Amar Neguev-yalaganse gannar nonimalad.
Ar Abram ibmar-durgan-bukidar-nika nonikid, mani-bukidar, degi, or-bukidar-nika nonikid. Degisoggu, dule-mani-ibedga gusad.
Neguev-akar, Abram gannar binna-binna alid. Betel-neggweburse geb warmakdapid. Geb degi, gannar naded, bia gebe na dordoneg sisagusadse. We-negde Betel-negabargi, degi, Hai-negabargi siid.
Agine, deunni, Abram Bab-Jehováʼga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila sobsa gusad. Agine, Abram Bab-Jehováʼse gocha gusad.
Lot amba dule-mani-ibedmogad. E-gilor-Abramʼyob sibad-wawaadmar, moli-bebe-nikamalad, degi, dordonegmar nikamogad.
Ar emar-mamaidgi, ibmar-durgan bukidar nikamarsoggu, ibmar-durganga mas unnisuli gualid. A-ular, Abram, Lot-ebogwa geg na walikaa gudigue guarmalad.

Molimarga mas unnisulidba, Abramʼga-dule-moli-bebe-nikad-akwemalad, Lotʼga-dule-moli-bebe-nikad-akwemalad-ebo na uluardamalad. Aginbali, a-ibagangine, Canaán-dulemar, degi, Ferezeo-dulemar a-yargine amba bukwamarmogad.

Ibagwengi Abram Lotʼga sokalid: “Anmar na gwenadgan gumalad. Degisoggu, anmar na boni-nika gudiile, ibnuedsulid. Degi, anga-moli-bebe-nikad-edarbemalad, bega-moli-bebe-nikad-edarbemarmogadbogwa urwemarmogale, we ibnuedsurbalid.

Emi be dakena, napa unniguar be-asabin naid. Degisoggu, be-abegedba na be sudo, igid bur be suoe. Degisoggu, angi be bangusun. Ar be argan-sapiledsik naye be sogele, andi argan-nuedsik naoed. Argan-nuedsik be naye sogele, andi argan-sapiledsik naoed.”

Lot bela Jordán-diwarsik Zoar-neggweburse neba-naid dakded. A-nebagi dii nue-nika, degine, Bab-Jehová-nainu-nuedyob-daklege dakalid. E-daklegedde Egipto-yaryob daklebalid. Ar Bab-Jehová Sodoma-neggwebur, degi, Gomorra-neggwebur-obelogoed-iduale, we-neggweburmar yeer daklegenad.
Geb degine, Lot bela Jordán-diwarsik-neba-naid susad. Na e-maidgi dad-nakwedsik nade gusad. Weyobi, Abram, Lot-ebogwa, na bangud gusmalad.
Abramʼdi, Canaán-yalagi besad. Lotʼdi, nade gusad. Nebagi neggweburmar-bukwadse megnade gusad. Geb Lot Sodoma-neggwebur-waliksaar e-dordornegmar sisad.
Sodomaʼgi dulemar-bukwad bela-bela isgana nanaed, isgued-dummagan Bab-Jehová-asabin imakdimalad.
Lot Abramʼgi-bangusad-sorba, Bab-Jehová Abramʼga sokalid: “Be-maidgi be dad-nakwedsik, dad-argwanedsik, dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsik, dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik nue be neg dako.
We-napnegmar be dakedi, bela bega an ukoed. We-yalagan begadga degi, be-wagangadga degisadegu guoed.
Ukubyob be-wagan yaisur-mergu, an imakoed. Ar igi ukub geg ebislege, deyobi, be-wagan geg ebisle gumogoed.
Degisoggu, emisgindi, bela we-yalaganba be nae, ar we-yala an bega ukoed.”

Geb degine, Abram nade gudsunnad, e-dordonegmar-siid sesa gusad. Abram Hebrón-neggwebur-walik megnaded, sapi-islidikmalad-Mamreʼgi-bukwadse. Agi, Abram Bab-Jehová-nuggi, Bab-Jehováʼga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila sobsad.
